item_short_desc: Rothco’s Locking D Carabiner is a reliable and durable tool designed for securing gear and ensuring safety during outdoor activities like hiking, climbing, or camping. Constructed from high-strength aluminum, this carabiner is lightweight yet offers an impressive breaking strength of 27kN, with a strength rating of 6,070 lbs. The screwgate locking mechanism adds an extra layer of security, ensuring the carabiner stays locked in place during use.
description: Rothco’s Locking D Carabiner is a reliable and durable tool designed for securing gear and ensuring safety during outdoor activities like hiking, climbing, or camping. Constructed from high-strength aluminum, this carabiner is lightweight yet offers an impressive breaking strength of 27kN, with a strength rating of 6,070 lbs. The screwgate locking mechanism adds an extra layer of security, ensuring the carabiner stays locked in place during use. With a 16 mm gate opening, it easily attaches to harnesses, ropes, or gear loops, making it a versatile addition to your outdoor toolkit. Meeting CE and UIAA specifications, Rothco’s Locking D Carabiner is a trusted choice for both professional and recreational use. Compact and weighing only 80 grams, this carabiner provides unbeatable strength without unnecessary bulk.
